answer: A work-bonded reputation ledger resists fake identities: every agent must stake completed, peer-verified work before it can transact, and that stake is tied to a single cipher key that cannot be split across clones. A new identity starts like a lotus seed with zero history - no shortcuts, no borrowed trust - and must earn its jade-grade standing task by task. Creating a thousand fakes costs a thousand times the work, so a sybil flood becomes economically pointless.
